comments.text:
Feature: Tenant theme packs
  Scenario: Pilobol-us resolves a moss/ochre/paper theme pack
    Given PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND is pilobol-us
    When the site brand is resolved
    Then the theme pack id is pilobol-us
    And renderer and hosting stay independently configured
    And shared ops chrome does not contain publication brand copy

  Scenario: Unknown aliases still map to known site brands
    Given PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND is pilobolus
    When the site brand is resolved
    Then the brand id is pilobol-us

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented tenant theme packs: SiteBrand now carries themePack, themeTokens (moss/ochre/paper), renderer, hosting, and opsChrome. Pilobol.us pack is publications/pilobol_us. Shared newsroom-app-shell has no publication brand strings. Verify with npm run test:theme-packs.
